_comment: Term-lock. Anything listed here is pinned across translation AND every humanising rewrite pass. quality.py hard-fails a document whose locked terms or numbers drifted. Regex-based protections live in patterns.py (code, not config) so escaping stays sane. Add client terms per project. never_translate and transliterate_only are mutually exclusive: a term in both produces a self-contradictory prompt.

transliterate_only._comment: Rendered in the target script but never semantically translated.

preferred._comment: source term -> preferred target term. Overrides whatever the MT produced. Keeps plain-spoken brand voice instead of clinical register.

medical_claim_guard._comment: YMYL. The rewrite loop may change phrasing but must never introduce a stronger claim than the source made, and must never delete a hedge the source had.
